title: Noční strach
desc: Kubu v noci vyleká stín na zdi. Lampička ukáže, že je to jen bunda — a medvídek je po ruce.
desc_en: A shadow on the wall scares Jake at night. The lamp shows it is only a jacket, and Teddy is right there.
world: a cozy child's bedroom at night, moonlight through the window, a bed with a star quilt, a toy shelf, a chair with clothes, soft blue night colors
setting: Útulný dětský pokojíček v noci: měsíční světlo z okna, postel s hvězdičkovou peřinou, polička s hračkami, židle s oblečením a tlumené modré barvy.
music: soft lullaby children's music, music box, celesta and warm strings, gentle and slightly mysterious then calm, instrumental, 70 bpm

jake.name: Kuba
jake.desc: a 6-year-old boy with fluffy red hair and big blue eyes, wearing light blue pajamas with yellow stars
jake.look: Šestiletý kluk s načechranými zrzavými vlasy a velkýma modrýma očima, ve světle modrém pyžamu se žlutými hvězdičkami.

teddy.name: medvídek Bručoun
teddy.desc: a soft old brown teddy bear with a patched ear, button eyes and a red bow tie
teddy.look: Měkký starý hnědý plyšový medvídek se záplatou na uchu, knoflíkovýma očima a červeným motýlkem.

shots.action: V tmavém pokojíčku leží Kuba pod hvězdičkovou peřinou s očima dokořán, po zdi se rozlévá měsíční světlo. Mrkne a vytáhne si peřinu k bradě.
shots.keyframe: Jake lies in bed under a star quilt in his dark bedroom, eyes wide open, moonlight on the wall
shots.motion: Jake lies in bed, blinks, and pulls the quilt up to his chin
shots.narration: Bylo zhasnuto. Kuba ale nemohl usnout.
shots.narration_en: The lights were out, but Jake couldn't sleep.

shots.action: Na zdi se kýve velký strašidelný stín s ostrými tvary. Kuba na něj zírá a svírá peřinu.
shots.keyframe: a big spooky shadow with pointy shapes on the bedroom wall, Jake in bed staring at it
shots.motion: the big shadow on the wall wobbles slightly, Jake stares at it and grips his quilt
shots.narration: Na zdi byl velký stín. Hýbal se!
shots.narration_en: A big shadow moved on the wall!

shots.action: Kuba sklouzne pod peřinu a koukají mu jen oči. Peřina se chvěje, ještě jednou vykoukne na zeď a zase si oči zakryje.
shots.keyframe: Jake hides under his star quilt in bed, only his eyes peeking out
motion: Jake slides down and hides under the quilt, then only his eyes peek out
the quilt trembles a little, Jake peeks at the wall again, then hides his eyes
shots.narration: Kuba se schoval pod peřinu. Srdíčko mu bušilo jako buben.
shots.narration_en: Jake hid under his quilt. His heart beat like a drum.

shots.action: Medvídek Bručoun se překlopí přes okraj poličky a měkce dopadne na koberec.
shots.keyframe: Teddy the bear falls from the toy shelf onto the soft carpet of the dark bedroom
shots.motion: the teddy bear tips over the edge of the shelf and tumbles softly onto the carpet
shots.narration_en: Thump! Something fell off the shelf.

shots.action: Kuba pomalu nadzvedne peřinu, vykulenýma očima kouká k zemi a ztuhne.
shots.keyframe: Jake peeks out from under the quilt with big scared eyes
shots.motion: Jake slowly lifts the quilt, peeks towards the floor with big eyes, then freezes
shots.narration_en: Jake held his breath and listened.

shots.action: Stín na zdi se natahuje do výšky a dlouhé ruce se mu kývají. Kuba si přetáhne peřinu přes nos.
shots.keyframe: the shadow on the bedroom wall grows taller, looking like a monster with long arms, Jake in bed below it
shots.motion: the shadow on the wall stretches taller, its long arms sway, Jake pulls the quilt over his nose
shots.narration_en: The shadow grew bigger and bigger.

shots.action: Kuba se nadechne a pomalu natáhne ruku k lampičce ve tvaru měsíce. Cvakne a pokoj zalije teplé žluté světlo.
shots.keyframe: Jake reaches out bravely from his bed to switch on a little moon-shaped bedside lamp
motion: Jake takes a deep breath and slowly reaches his hand towards the lamp
Jake clicks the lamp on, warm yellow light fills the room and he blinks
shots.narration: Pak se nadechl, natáhl ruku… a rozsvítil lampičku.
shots.narration_en: Then he took a breath, reached out… and switched on the lamp.

shots.action: Ve světle lampičky visí na židli bunda a šála a lehce se pohupují. Kuba se na ně podívá a začne se chichotat.
shots.keyframe: in warm lamp light a jacket and a scarf hang on a chair next to the bed, Jake sits in bed looking at them
shots.motion: the jacket and scarf on the chair sway gently, Jake looks at them, then starts to giggle
shots.narration: Stín byla jen bunda a šála na židli!
shots.narration_en: The shadow was just his jacket on a chair!

shots.action: Kuba zvedne Bručouna z koberce, pevně ho obejme a usměje se.
shots.keyframe: Jake picks up Teddy the bear from the carpet and hugs him in the warm lamp light
shots.motion: Jake lifts the teddy bear from the carpet and hugs it tightly, smiling
shots.narration: A na zemi ležel medvídek Bručoun.
shots.narration_en: And there on the floor lay Teddy.

shots.action: Kuba v pyžamu tančí na koberci makarenu: ruce dopředu, na ramena, na boky a malý skok.
shots.keyframe: Jake stands on the carpet next to his bed in his pajamas in the warm lamp light, laughing
shots.motion: Jake dances the macarena on the spot, hands out, hands on shoulders, hands on hips and a little jump, same pajamas, same bedroom
shots.narration: Kubovi se tak ulevilo, že zatančil makarenu.
shots.narration_en: Jake felt so relieved he danced the macarena.

shots.action: Kuba uloží Bručouna pod peřinu, pohladí ho po hlavě a lehne si vedle něj.
shots.keyframe: Jake tucks Teddy the bear into bed next to him under the star quilt
shots.motion: Jake tucks the teddy under the quilt, pats its head and lies down next to it
shots.narration_en: He tucked Teddy in beside him.

shots.action: Kuba klidně spí s Bručounem v náručí a lampička tiše svítí.
shots.keyframe: Jake sleeps peacefully hugging Teddy the bear, the moon lamp glowing softly
shots.motion: Jake breathes slowly in his sleep hugging the teddy, the lamp glows softly
shots.narration: Už se nebál. Dobrou noc, Kubo.
shots.narration_en: He wasn't scared anymore. Good night, Jake.
